title: 정이 뭐야?
scene: 겨울밤, 서아네 집. 서아 엄마가 학습자에게 반찬을 싸 준다. 「정」이라는 말을 처음 듣는다
goal: Understanding 정 (jeong) — Korean warmth you can't refuse

turns.speaker: C
turns.en: {name} take this, kimchi and stir-fried anchovies

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: No it's okay! It's too much

turns.speaker: C
turns.ko: 뭐가 많아 혼자 사는데 밥은 먹어야지
turns.rd: mwoga mana honja saneunde babeun meogeoyaji
turns.en: What's too much, you live alone you have to eat

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Just take it, if you refuse she gives more

turns.speaker: B
turns.note: 정 = affection / attachment — hard to translate

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Hmm… it's hard to explain, it's just… this

turns.speaker: C
turns.ko: 반찬통은 다음 주에 와서 돌려줘 밥 먹고 가
turns.rd: banchantongeun daeum jue waseo dollyeojwo bap meokgo ga
turns.en: Return the containers next week, come and eat
turns.note: Kick: the container = a reason to come back

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 아… 그래서 통을 돌려줘야 하는 거구나
turns.rd: a… geuraeseo tongeul dollyeojwoya haneun geoguna
turns.en: Oh… so that's why I have to return the container
turns.note: -는 거구나 = ah, so that's how it is

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 그니까 그게 정이야 빠져나갈 수 없어
turns.rd: geunikka geuge jeongiya ppajyeonagal su eopseo
turns.en: Exactly that's jeong, you can't escape it

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: …Thank you, I'll definitely come next week

turns.speaker: C
turns.ko: 그래 올 때 빈손으로 와 또 싸 줄 테니까
turns.rd: geurae ol ttae binsoneuro wa tto ssa jul tenikka
turns.en: Good, come empty-handed, I'll pack more

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 빈손으로요? 한국에서는 뭐 사 가야 하는 거 아니에요?
turns.rd: binsoneuroyo? hangugeseoneun mwo sa gaya haneun geo anieyo?
turns.en: Empty-handed? Don't you bring something in Korea?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: To my mom, you coming is the gift

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: …That sounds exactly like a drama line
